title: Alternative units within similar board structures

cases.title: Lillia versus Malphite in Soraka/Zyra boards
cases.subject: units
cases.original_question: How do Soraka and Zyra boards with Lillia as the main tank compare with similar boards using Malphite? Are there versions where Lillia holds up, or is she usually a weaker substitute?
cases.question: How do Soraka and Zyra boards with Lillia as the main tank compare with similar boards using Malphite? Are there versions where Lillia holds up, or is she usually a weaker substitute?
cases.scenario: Primary interpretation: final level eight, both Soraka2 and Zyra2, exactly one Lillia2 or Malphite2 with an explicit three-item defensive build; dual-tank boards separate.
cases.plan: Discover candidate tank trios and support packages, then compare disjoint named tank cohorts within the shared carry/star/level shell. query_cohort reports deployed-unit count, item budget and Fae/Defender/Blackthorn support; repeat named common-core comparisons with actual item identities.
cases.checks: Carry the two-carry interpretation into input. Show both tank samples/outcomes and any supported alternative contexts, with differences in trait package stated. Preserve star and defensive-build definitions; do not pool single-carry families silently.
cases.limits: Final level is not actual capacity; exact whole-board matching and Blackthorn choice are unavailable. Three items alone do not prove three defensive items.

cases.title: Ashe versus Draven on Maokai boards
cases.subject: units
cases.original_question: Is Ashe really the better carry than Draven on Maokai endgame boards, or are they succeeding in different versions of the board?
cases.question: Is Ashe really the better carry than Draven on Maokai endgame boards, or are they succeeding in different versions of the board?
cases.scenario: Final level nine, itemized Maokai2, exactly one Ashe2 or Draven2 with three completed items; dual carries, level ten and one-star carry versions separate.
cases.plan: Discover carry/tank exact loadouts and support units; compare the two exclusive carry packages with shared Maokai investment and level. Query actual support and Elder Dragon presence, then repeat inside supported named core/Dragon strata.
cases.checks: Report counts/outcomes for common and different variants; explain whether the pooled ordering persists inside inspected overlaps. AP/AD or carry-specific build suitability means forced identical trios are not required. No all-board Maokai marginal answers this.
cases.limits: Generic legendary count, accumulated Maokai health, Draven rewards and occupied capacity are not filterable. Observe named legendaries and unit-record counts without claiming exact wealth matching.

cases.title: Elder Dragon versus Ezreal supporting packages
cases.subject: units
cases.original_question: Among finished Draven–Maokai boards, how do the Elder Dragon and Ezreal versions compare for top fours and wins once board size, upgrades and emblem differences are accounted for?
cases.question: Among finished Draven–Maokai boards, how do the Elder Dragon and Ezreal versions compare for top fours and wins once board size, upgrades and emblem differences are accounted for?
cases.scenario: Final level-nine Draven2/Maokai2 boards with equal declared main-carry/tank investment; itemized Elder Dragon2 versus Ezreal2, primary groups excluding the other candidate.
cases.plan: Compare explicit secondary-holder packages inside the shared core after discovering exact itemizations. Query board_size, total completed items, traits and support-unit rows; separate named emblem variants and inspect whether the occupied-slot comparison can actually be certified.
cases.checks: Report mean/top4/win separately, full comparison histograms and samples where possible. Keep Elder Dragon's double-capacity issue visible and show changed supporting packages rather than presenting equal level as equal deployed capacity.
cases.limits: board_size counts unit records; actual occupied capacity and boardwide no-emblem categories are not exposed predicates. A fully capacity-matched gold comparison needs prepared aggregate evidence; the current route is a qualified package comparison.
